changelog:
Fixes long recordings failing to upload with "Aborted".

Uploads were capped at 60 seconds by a library default. An hour-long meeting is well over 100 MB and takes longer than that on normal WiFi, so the transfer was cut off partway - affecting only long recordings, which are exactly the ones worth recovering.

The cap is now 30 minutes. Your recording is never deleted until your desktop confirms a finished transcript, so nothing was lost - re-sync and it will go through.
